changeReason: V1.3 used an absolute token budget whose cost behavior depends on average message length. V1.4 predeclares a base-relative token grid before any LoCoMo retrieval run. The effective budget is min(1024, ratio times the exact token load of the original Top-5). All LongMemEval baselines are rerun; the selected policy is then frozen for an external LoCoMo stress test.
